Original: https://github.com/assimp/assimp/releases/tag/v6.0.4
Upgraded from 4.1.0 to 6.0.4 on 2026-03-24

Changes from the original 6.0.4
================================

root:
* removed dirs: doc, packaging, port, samples, scripts, test, tools
* changed file: CMakeLists.txt (Urho3D static lib integration)

CMakeLists.txt changes:
* Version set to 6.0.4, SOVERSION 6
* Disabled: Hunter, Draco, USD, VRML, X3D, M3D, C4D, install targets
* Added TARGET_USE_COMMON_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY no-op macro
* Hardcoded git info (no git commands at configure time)
* System zlib with fallback to bundled contrib/zlib
* Added code/ to include directories for internal headers

code/CMakeLists.txt: unmodified from 6.0.4

AssetImporter CMakeLists.txt:
* Changed library name from Assimp to assimp (6.0.4 uses lowercase target)
